records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} can give a longing, image, spiritual pull, or creative idea somewhere new to go. Neptune makes possibility feel emotionally convincing; the New Moon is early enough that you can follow the inspiration without treating the feeling as proof.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can make a vision feel like destiny before its shape is clear. Neptune can sense what might be possible, while the eclipse speeds up the urge to believe it. Keep the imagination; wait for enough evidence to know what belongs to the vision and what belongs to the projection.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can dissolve an explanation that was holding because nobody wanted to look too closely at the cost. Neptune may still make the ending feel ambiguous, but the eclipse can make the lived consequence impossible to explain away.
